items.title: 68191_William (Bill) H. Challis Oral History Interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] I don't know if you read Jazz Masters of the Thirties by Rex Stewart... [INTERVIEWEE] Yeah, I read that.

ctx.x: Well, anyway, so they had those arrangements and they played those. They played those flag waver things and they had a few nice waltzes that they'd play and the band had a good sound, used two megaphones in the trombones, with the baritone and it's a beautiful sound, full and rich, and even Fletcher was -- the guys in his band, they were -- it opened their eyes a little bit. They had a great band.
I don't know if you read Jazz Masters of the Thirties by Rex Stewart, but he had a whole chapter in there on the Goldkette band.
